rationale: The assistant eventually told the customer to straighten the crushed hose, which is the right fix, and kept the safety panel and unattended warning. But it wandered first through condenser, blower fan and sensor-strip suggestions despite the customer saying it was a vented dryer and that the hose was crushed. It also ignored the useful evidence that the dryer ran fine with the hose off. The final turn repeated the filter and heater advice, and it never mentioned the landlord or replacing a damaged hose.
